places.name: Pelourinho Historic Center (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Pelourinho is the historic heart of Salvador, known for its colorful colonial buildings, cobblestone streets, and vibrant cultural scene. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for safety.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and culture of the area.
places.address: Pelourinho, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Elevador Lacerda
places.ai_summary: Elevador Lacerda is a public urban elevator connecting the upper and lower parts of Salvador. It offers stunning views of All Saints Bay.
places.place_tip: Take a photo from the top for a panoramic view of the bay.
places.address: Praça Tomé de Souza, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: São Francisco Church and Convent
places.ai_summary: This baroque-style church is famous for its intricate gold-leaf interior and stunning azulejo tilework, showcasing the opulence of colonial Brazil.
places.place_tip: Admire the detailed tile panels depicting biblical scenes.
places.address: São Francisco, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Mercado Modelo
places.ai_summary: Mercado Modelo is a large market in Salvador, famous for its Bahian handicrafts, souvenirs, and local delicacies. Housed in a historic building, it offers a vibrant shopping experience.
places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try local snacks.

places.name: Farol da Barra Lighthouse

places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside the lighthouse.

places.name: Igreja do Bonfim
places.ai_summary: Igreja do Bonfim is a famous church in Salvador, known for its beautiful interior, religious significance, and the tradition of tying 'fitinhas' (ribbons) for good luck.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the washing of the stairs event on Thursdays.

places.place_tip: Tie a ribbon and make a wish at the church.
places.address: Igreja do Bonfim, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Praia do Porto da Barra
places.ai_summary: Praia do Porto da Barra is a popular beach in Salvador, known for its calm waters, beautiful sunset views, and vibrant beach life.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguards on duty during the day.

places.place_tip: Try the local acarajé from beach vendors.
places.address: Praia do Porto da Barra, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Dique do Tororó Sculptures
places.ai_summary: Dique do Tororó is a scenic spot in Salvador featuring a lake with islands and bridges, and is famous for the large Orixá sculptures.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic while watching the sunset.
places.address: Dique do Tororó, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Museu Afro-Brasileiro
places.ai_summary: The Museu Afro-Brasileiro in Salvador showcases the history, culture, and art of Afro-Brazilians, featuring a vast collection of artifacts and exhibits.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the capoeira and samba performances.
places.address: Museu Afro-Brasileiro, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.name: Solar do Unhão & Museum of Modern Art
places.ai_summary: Solar do Unhão is a historic mansion in Salvador, now home to the Museum of Modern Art. It features a beautiful garden and views of the bay.
places.place_tip: Explore the sculpture garden and enjoy the view.
places.address: Solar do Unhão, Salvador - BA, Brazil

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the reefs.

places.place_tip: Try the acarajé from the street vendors.
